rule_or_pattern: Drop (1) lines whose label carries the misread numismatic metal sign before a denomination: (?:^|[\s.])(?:Ο|ΚΕ|[AP]\.|Α\.|Ρ\.)\s*(?:[Σσ]τατ|[Δδ]ρ|[Tτ]ετρ|[Δδ]ίδρ|[Ὀὀ]βολ|[Ἡἡ]μ); (2) labels containing '|' or a marginal heading appended after a hyphenated break (e.g. 'βασι- Μακεδονία'); (3) D:column_merge_line lines on the two-column catalogue pages.
notes: This is Svoronos's 1898 Greek translation of Head's Historia Numorum. Running text (1, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12-16, 26, 28, 33-34, 38, 40), the index lines (18-20) and the Latin citations (21, 22) read correctly with good polytonic marks. The column_crossing flag mostly hits real full-width prose lines. The systematic fault is the special metal signs of the coin catalogue: the silver sign 'AR' is read as 'Ο' (5, 31, and 'Ο Στατὴρ' several times on the page image) or as 'A.'/'P.', and the electrum sign as 'ΚΕ' (30). Catalogue entries set in two narrow columns are sometimes joined across the rule ('|' in 23, 'στέφα- ΙΕΛΕ Ἔλαφος' in 35, two index entries in 37), and 2 has the side heading 'Μακεδονία.' appended.
